reason: Both correctly keep the "every boat" claim out and catch the mismatch between the 9% argument and the 3-fish ask, but B gives Ray an honest route to the strong claim he wants (his own break-even) and reshapes the review ask into something data-based that staff-trusting commissioners can accept.
